The property has a beautiful, spacious lobby, friendly and attentive staff, and a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere. The pool area was great, and the poolside restaurant and bar offered one of the most breathtaking sunset views we've ever experienced. The beach was another highlight — clean, peaceful, and perfect…

What a beautiful resort—this place truly epitomises a Balinese paradise. From the serenity of its established, rambling gardens to its incredible waterfront location, every detail invites relaxation. With multiple swimming pools and lounging areas, there’s no shortage of places to unwind and soak in the surroundings. The culinary offerings are equally impressive, delivering a delightful dining experience throughout…

We spent three wonderful nights at InterContinental Bali Resort celebrating our 13th wedding anniversary, and it was an amazing experience. The resort has a beautiful, peaceful atmosphere with lush tropical gardens, relaxing water features, and a stunning beachfront. Watching the sunset from the beach sunbeds was the highlight of our stay. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making our anniversary even…

rv.t: If you enjoy deer and a great view of Nara, this is an easy to reach area. I highly suggest walking the road instead of driving. There are many other sights to see on the way. It adds to the experience significantly.

Mount Wakakusa (Wakakusayama) in Nara is an easy/moderate. Beautiful. summit. - [ ] We spent 3 hours in the premises. Although according to review we supposed to take 40 minutes to the lower viewpoint, and another 20 minutes to the top.

I don’t know how anyone can rate this place below 5 stars. I woke up early, walked through Nara park and then through the Kasuga Primeval Forest up to Mt Wakakusa. I was the only person on Mt Wakakusa for 15 minutes and got to enjoy the scenery and tranquil autumn weather in absolute peace. An unforgettable experience. Just me, the sights, and my deer friends. You can see Kyoto in the distance. The photos and videos…

rv.t: Kasuga Taisha is one of Nara's most remarkable landmarks and a designated UNESCO World Heritage Site. Nestled within the ancient forest of Kasugayama, the shrine complex is surrounded by towering trees that create a tranquil atmosphere unlike anywhere else in the city. Simply walking through the grounds feels like stepping into another era. The approach to the shrine is an experience in itself. Passing beneath rows…

Kasugataisha Shrine is one of the most serene and peaceful places I’ve visited in Nara. The moment you enter the grounds, you’re surrounded by lush greenery, towering ancient trees, and a natural quietness that feels almost timeless. The pathways lined with moss‑covered lanterns create a beautiful blend of nature and tradition. Not to mention the deers roaming freely along the way. Deep inside this forested area…

Really enjoyed this shrine. Lanterns everywhere, just wish we could see this at night. Beautiful architecture. The deer here are quite docile until you bring out the rice crackers! They know who does and they come from all over the place to get some!

1210.edj: カウンター席を備える古民家風の大衆的な店内で、各種のうどんやおにぎりを提供する。団子やあんみつなどの甘味もある。

rv.t: Very packed with people, expect waiting time. The service is fast, when you finish your food you are expected to leave and let other people eat, so its kinda fast. The sell deer cookies, if you want them buy two packs, the next seller is far 😃 The food is very good and reasonably priced, I enjoyed my udon with mushrooms very much ❤️

This noodle shop is situated at the end of your spiritual journey from Kasuga Taisha Shrine walking along Nara Park towards a small walkway bridge over a flowing creek. This serene place serves savory udon / soba noodles, snacks, and sweets like their delicious matcha ice cream or shaved ice along with several selection of teas. Cold water and hot green tea are free on a dispenser. Itadakimasu. OISHIIDES. What’s…

This was a pleasant stop. There was a line, but the service was very fast, so we ordered and got our food in no time. The udon noodles were good, I personally prefer them a bit firmer. The wild plants version was excellent, even better than the shrimp one.

They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere, free resting facilities, and well-maintained public restrooms. Some reviews mention the climb can be physically demanding.
1212.edj: この展望台を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、周囲の山々や遠くの街並みを一望できる素晴らしいパノラマビューが高く評価されています。遅咲きの桜を見るのに最適な場所だという声もあります。また、穏やかな雰囲気や無料の休憩施設、きれいに管理された公衆トイレも良い点として挙げられています。 一部のクチコミでは、展望台までの道のりが体力的にきついという意見もあります。

rv.t: Beautiful viewpoint with a peaceful atmosphere and amazing panoramic views. 🌄 Perfect spot to relax, take photos, and enjoy nature away from the busy city. Definitely worth the visit! ✨
Best place to view fall foliage. Best color at 3rd week of November. Highly recommend to take rollaway then bus up there first before going other places, which save your energy from climbing up hill.

The slope lies quiet and drowsy under the winter snow. Not a soul is in sight, adding to the serene, untouched beauty of the landscape. Winter transforms the scene into something entirely new—calm, still, and almost otherworldly.

Came here last Thursday. I went up from Amami village to Mt. Iwawaki and came down via Takihata dam. Pine forest, tunnel, scenic trail, and the last section at the peak is a open field. No way to describe it in full, you need to see for your self.

Minoh Falls is one of the most beautiful nature spots near Osaka and a perfect escape from the city like 40 minutes by train from Umeda. The waterfall itself is stunning, especially during autumn when the colorful leaves create an incredible atmosphere, but the area is beautiful and relaxing throughout the entire year. The walk to the falls is peaceful and filled with nature, making it a great place to slow down and…

Minoh Waterfall is an absolute must-do while in Japan, especially if you're based in Osaka and craving a peaceful break from the city hustle. The highlight starts right away with the nice, easy walk up to the falls—about 2.7–3 km one way along a well-paved trail through a beautiful forested valley. It's a gentle uphill stroll (around 45 minutes without rushing), perfect for all ages, and the fresh air and sounds of…

rv.t: This is an interesting curry place. It's on the 2nd floor and has a very cool vibe. It's clearly a bar at night, so its full of all the usual bar accoutrements. Dart board. Lots of TVs. Alcohol posters on the wall. There were also tons of Christmas decorations when I was there, because it was mid-November. The whole place smelled like delicious curry, which was great because that's what I wanted. A student in one of…

【Far More Than Just a Famous Name: The Exceptional Quality of Makio Curry】 Tucked away in the backstreets of Sangenjaya is "Sangenjaya Caligari Makio Curry." While it often grabs headlines as a restaurant run by a well-known comedian, I recently had the chance to try it via a takeout order, and I was completely blown away by its true potential. It is easy for a place like this to be judged solely on its celebrity…

Out and about on a beautiful Saturday afternoon when I got a craving for curry so I decided to give Caligary Makio curry a try. The staff were amazingly friendly and the spicy chicken curry was delicious. Great flavor though not really spicy. Plus, if you go around the right time of the year, you can get a signed invitation to see a Japanese comedy, apparently the owner is a professional actor/comedian. Cool beans!!

Great restaurant and perfect blend of spices. The lassi was perfect , and I especially liked the green spice in it. Unique, fresh taste. Like new! The stairs were well-built and solid. 1236.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and rich milk tea soft serve, as well as its flavorful scones served with ample clotted cream and jam. They also highlight the wide variety of teas available with free refills, and the cozy, charming atmosphere.
1236.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、濃厚で美味しいミルクティーソフトクリームや、たっぷりのクロテッドクリームとジャムが添えられた風味豊かなスコーンが高く評価されています。また、種類豊富な紅茶が飲み放題であることや、居心地の良い魅力的な雰囲気も特徴です。

rv.t: Ordered Kiki cream tea classic set, the 2 fresh hot scones are 5 star hotel quality, the home made lemons curd is not too sweet, very refreshing… In this set, you can try different teas on the menu, I loved the Amsu angel jasmine tea, & bought a bag from Kiki. This Japanese brand tea blend is the best Jasmine flavor I’ve ever tried. & I usually drink some blends from TWG, Harney & Sons, & global 5 star hotel tea…

We ate here for breakfast, the service was lovely kind staff, delicious food we had the English breakfast set menu with toast and tea I had the lemon curd it was very delicious and my husband had raspberry it was really good too overall amazing food I recommend coming the tea is really good there is a massive variety to enjoy the table wear and plates and cup are so beautiful too very pretty and luxury I love!
We could try various teas with the tea-free option: at each refill they serve you a random tea flavour. The carrot cake was nice, the scone was dense and crispy outside.

1237.a: Yushin Valley, Kurokura, Yamakita, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa 258-0202, Japan
1237.aj: 〒258-0202 神奈川県足柄上郡山北町玄倉ユーシン渓谷
1237.ed: Visitors say this valley offers stunning "Yushin Blue" translucent waters, especially near Kurokura Dam and the second power station, with many highlighting the beautiful autumn colors. They also mention the path is mostly flat and easy to walk, making it suitable for hiking. Others recommend bringing a flashlight for the dark tunnels and note the convenient free parking with nearby restrooms and…
1237.edj: この渓谷を訪れた人は、特に玄倉ダムや第二発電所付近の「ユーシンブルー」と呼ばれる透き通った水の色が素晴らしいと評価しています。また、美しい紅葉の時期に訪れることをおすすめする声も多くあります。道はほとんど平坦で歩きやすく、ハイキングに適しているというクチコミがあります。暗いトンネルがあるため、懐中電灯の持参が必須とされています。無料駐車場にはトイレや自動販売機があり、便利だという意見もあります。

rv.t: The Yushin Valley is perfect for those looking for a world heritage-class view. This popular valley is nicknamed "Yushin Blue" due to its blue, translucent waters. It's 45 minute bus ride from the Shin-Matsuda station on the Odakyu Line, followed by a bus ride to Kurokura bus stop. The hike begins along the Kurokura River which is approximately 7km. You can enjoy the view of Lake Tanzawa while walking along the…

Beautiful Yushin Valley Very nice valley with amazing scenery. It’s about a 20 km round walk from the free parking area. The path is mostly flat with a few uphill sections, and the feeling throughout the walk is really peaceful. Autumn colors are beautiful here, and I want to visit again in summer. Highly recommended for nature lovers!
Beautiful but need to walk more

They also highlight the excellent quality of the wagyu beef and other dishes, noting the reasonable prices for the generous portions. Guests mention the clean and stylish atmosphere, along with the attentive and friendly staff who…
1238.edj: この焼肉店を利用した人は、新鮮で風味豊かなユッケの種類の多さを高く評価しています。特に、人気の「飲めるユッケ丼」や見た目も華やかなピラミッドユッケが有名です。また、和牛の質の高さやその他の料理も絶賛されており、ボリューム満点なのに値段が手頃であることにも触れています。店内は清潔感がありおしゃれな雰囲気で、スタッフの丁寧で親しみやすい対応が食事体験をより良いものにしているという声が多くあります。

rv.t: The lift lobby located on the side. Large signboard downstairs but didn't state which floor. It's at level 3, you are welcome. Came for their lunch. Giant balls of raw marinated meat on rice. Add on some raw eggs. Although the explanation is primitive but the dining experience isn't. Staff came and explained how to eat , came to the lift and bow when you finish. Japanese service hospitality. Food is the critical…

Went for lunch on a weekday. It was busy but I didn't need a reservation. The staff are friendly and helpful. They offer hardcopy and digital menus with pictures and descriptions. I ordered the M size yukke bowl set. It came with salad and soup. The soup was salty but good. The salad had a nice dressing. The yukke bowl was smaller than expected but still a decent size. The meat was delicious but the rice was a…

Everything was delicious — it was truly a wonderful dining experience. All of the staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and we would especially like to thank the manager, Atsushi (Mr. Suzumura), who made our meal even more enjoyable with his warm hospitality and friendly manner. We genuinely felt the care and passion behind the service, which made us feel very happy to be here today. It was a memorable and…

rv.t: Had a great days staying in this hotel. Everyday to get a 10 mins morning walk to the nearest subway station with the cold weather was just nice! Hotel also provides bus to the nearest subway station as per schedule. You will get a nice Tokyo Skytree view everyday. No matter which side of the room you stay, you will still get a nice view. The toilet seat is hot and comfortable, enjoying every time. Water pressure is…

The room is spacious and good location. Takes 7-8 mins walk to Toyoko Station. There’s supermarket and some restaurants linked to the hotel so it’s quite convenient. Hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Free shuttle bus to Disneyland. The most important is direct bus from hotel lobby to narita airport, hassle free from carrying luggage to subway station.

This was a combination of a business trip and a long-overdue getaway with my mom. I initially panicked because I accidentally booked a package that didn't include breakfast. However, thanks to the kind assistance of Front Desk Manager Budhathoki Dipak, we were able to comfortably enjoy both breakfast and the sauna throughout our stay. All the staff members were incredibly friendly, and the room was very clean. The…

1240.a: Uzukino Honten, 2 Chome-2-1 Senjuazuma, Adachi City, Tokyo 120-0025, Japan
1240.aj: 〒120-0025 東京都足立区千住東２丁目２−１ 宇豆基野
1240.ed: Tranquil shop & restaurant specializing in tofu & namafu, with sit-down fixed-menu meals or takeout.
1240.edj: 豆腐や生麩の販売店に併設された料理店。落ち着きのある店内でセットメニューを提供。テイクアウト メニューもある。

rv.t: 場所は、北千住駅から徒歩５、６分。 閑静な住宅街に、こちらのお店があります。 建物が結構大きいのに驚いた！！ お店の入口は、ゆるい階段が３段ほどか、スロープがあります。 お店に入ると、大豆の香りがしていて、湯葉すくいをする場所が目の前にあります。 あと、店内販売もあるみたいで、お弁当とかお豆腐、湯葉なんかも売っていました。 こちらだけじゃなく、北千住の丸井やスカイツリーのソラマチにもお店があるそうです。 店員さんへ予約名を伝えると席へ案内をしてくれます。 席は、１階にあるテーブル席のみで、２６席とのこと。 ２名、４名席がメインですが、もっと多いと席を付けたりするみたい。 この日も満席とのことでしたが、２名はドタキャンがあったみたい。 お店側は事前に準備をしているので、ギリギリでのキャンセルは出来たら止めた方が良い。 そして、12時の回だったのですが、時間ぴったりにスタート。 はじめに店員さんから挨拶と説明があります。…

ここでしかできない生ゆばすくい体験 都内で唯一ここでしかできない、生ゆばすくい体験ができるお店を紹介します！北千住にある「宇豆基野」は老舗の豆腐工房で、土日祝日限定でゆば懐石料理が食べられます。中に入ると大きなゆば釜がお出迎えです。落ち着いた雰囲気で、生ゆばを楽しめるお店ですので是非ご覧ください。 ◆ゆばを余す事なく楽しむことができる 豆乳カクテルジュースから始まり、ゆばのお刺身3種食べ比べができて、歯応えのあるゆばからトロトロ食感、甘さの違いまでゆばを余す事なく楽しむことができるんです！それぞれのゆばに個性があって、食べ比べが楽しいです。 ◆その場で手作りのお豆腐、生麩の田楽、鰻の乗ったサラダ その場で手作りのお豆腐も食べられて、生麩の田楽、鰻の乗ったサラダまであります。一品一品が丁寧に作られていて、上品な味が楽しめます。 ◆自分で食べたい分だけゆばすくいを体験できる…

うずきの。 奇跡的に予約が取れて伺いました。 お豆腐好きとしては、汲み上げ湯葉が食べ放題というだけで夢のよう。 できたての湯葉はなめらかで、優しい味わいに感動しました。 お料理はコースでまとめられていて、予約者全員が一斉にスタート。 一品ずつ丁寧に説明があり、どれも本当に美味しかったです。 静かで落ち着いた雰囲気の中で、上品な時間を過ごせました。 今度はお豆腐のテイクアウトでも訪れたいです。 また予約が取れたら、ぜひ再訪したいお店。

1241.ed: Grassy, hilly lava plateau, home to wild buffalo & a popular destination for hiking.
1241.edj: 野生のバッファローが生息し、ハイキングの人気の終着点である、草原の丘陵に富んだ溶岩台地。

rv.t: Qingtiangang Grassland (擎天崗草原) is one of the most scenic and popular attractions in Yangmingshan National Park. Located high in the Datun volcanic mountain range north of Taipei, the area is famous for its vast rolling meadows, open landscapes, grazing water buffalo, and breathtaking mountain views. Qingtiangang is often described as one of the easiest ways to experience Taiwan's volcanic highland scenery. With its…

So glad we came! If you do one thing in the national park, you won't regret making this it. There are very clean and well maintained paths that lead to multiple 1-4 km hikes. You can get a fantastic view of the city from one of the taller peaks.

Incredibly beautiful place for either a hike or just to take pictures! The intensity of the hikes depends on how far you’re willing to go! We went a whole round, up and down the hills. Took us around 2 hours ish, including short breaks in between. The weather wasn’t too harsh thankfully. There are also water buffaloes everywhere! Be sure to maintain a distance as they’re free roaming. Everything is thoughtfully…

1242.a: BERTH COFFEE ROASTERY "Haru", 2 Chome-7-2 Yokokawa, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0003, Japan

1242.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, high-quality coffee, including various single-origin beans and excellent lattes, along with tasty sweets like carrot cake and seasonal cheesecakes. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, who provide great service and helpful tips. Visitors appreciate the cozy, relaxed atmosphere and the convenience of cashless payment.
1242.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、高品質でおいしいコーヒーが提供されているというクチコミが多くあります。特に、様々な種類のシングルオリジン豆や、素晴らしいラテが高く評価されているようです。また、キャロットケーキや季節限定のチーズケーキなど、おいしいスイーツも評判です。親切で気の利くスタッフのサービスも好評で、役立つ情報を提供してくれるという声もあります。居心地の良いリラックスした雰囲気や、キャッシュレス決済が利用できる点も、訪れた人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Good flavor coffee with cozy space to rest after hard working. High recommend for carrot cake. Minimal looking but good taste. Not too sweet. Ume tree in front of the cafe make me smile every time I looked at them.

Great selection of coffees with flavor profiles explained(in English too, a plus for me!). Friendly staff and cozy atmosphere. Had an Ethiopian coffee pour over with cheese toast. A perfect start to the day.

We stumbled upon this gorgeous place by accident at the exact moment we needed it most. Real coffee by the roasters themselves.... AND they offered an alternative milk! I had walked out of 4 other coffee cafes without coffee as I cant have cows milk and I was craving. Thank you so much for your service and really wonderful coffee 🫶🙏

1243.a: Oshiage Tenso Shrine, 2 Chome-13-13 Narihira, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0002, Japan

rv.t: Cool Shrine near the station in Tokyo. Easy to find.

A beautiful shrine giving some peace in the middle of the city. A bit surreal with the view of the Tokyo Sky Tree right above the roofs. The neighborhood really feels full of contrasts. You can also purchase fortunes at the front.
Nice, modest shrine. A good place to unwind and catch your breath after visiting Skytree.

1244.a: Sumida Coffee, 4 Chome-7-11 Taihei, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0012, Japan

1244.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including a flavorful Sumida blend, and popular desserts like coffee soft-serve and rich cheese toast. They also highlight the beautiful Edo Kiriko cups and the calm, relaxing atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are kind and attentive, contributing to a pleasant experience.
1244.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、おいしいコーヒーやデザートを高く評価しています。特に、風味豊かな「すみだブレンド」や、コーヒーソフトクリーム、濃厚なチーズトーストが評判のようです。美しい江戸切子のカップで提供される点や、落ち着いた雰囲気も特徴として挙げられています。また、スタッフが親切で丁寧なため、心地よく過ごせるというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: A nice cosy cafe which serves up great coffee! I had the cheesecake as well, and the lady who makes the coffee was very patient in answering my questions and recommending a coffee for my palate. If you ask for milk, they'll give you a very small pitcher, which though not my usual allowed the taste of the coffee to shine through..enjoyed the coffee so much, I bought a bag of the beans to go! Highly recommended!

Such a cute shop that exists in a renovated home. I came 5 mins after it opened on a Friday and almost every table was already full. The chocolate chip scone was decent. The Ethiopia pour over was delicious. The staff was really kind and helpful. Since it’s such a small and popular coffee shop, there is a 60 minute seating limit in place.

A warm and delightful little cafe. Coffee tastes great and there is a large variety of cakes that change throughout the seasons. Cheesecake is their specialty and I would definitely taking its mocha version. Staff is helpful and very kind. I usually go there twice a month !

Tucked away on a quiet street in Sumida, it has the kind of peaceful, local atmosphere that’s becoming harder to find. The cozy ambience makes it the perfect place to slow down, unwind, and enjoy a break from the busy pace of Tokyo. The stars of the visit were undoubtedly the Yuzu Matcha and the Basque cheesecake…

We had the most amazing breakfast here. The owner was so accommodating and kind, despite our early arrival and large group. The toast, coffee, and banana bread were all delectable. No notes. The space, while on the smaller side, is beautifully designed and modern.

We stopped here for a morning coffee with our children. The lemon and matcha cheesecakes were delicious. And the Colombian and Ethiopian filter by hand coffee was really good. As good as a great Australian coffee shop. Clear and delicate flavours. Would definitely recommend. And the atmosphere was perfect. Minimalist wood and powder coated steel and quiet. The menu was in English and the barista was proficient in…

Visitors appreciate the friendly and helpful staff, who provide excellent service and plant care advice.
1246.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、アイスラテをはじめとする美味しいコーヒーや、毎日焼きたての様々なスイーツを高く評価しています。また、美しい植物に囲まれた居心地の良い魅力的な雰囲気は、リラックスできる特別な体験になるとの声が多くあります。親切で気の利くスタッフは、素晴らしいサービスを提供し、植物の育て方についてもアドバイスしてくれると評判です。

rv.t: Absolutely love this little hidden gem of a coffee shop near the Tokyo Skytree. Selling plants AND coffee, the shop has this amazing vibe and atmosphere! Super friendly owner too ☺️

The coffee was one of the best I had in Japan, and the shop and employees are sweet and warm! It’s a small shop, so despite being close to the Skytree it’s not the best for large group seating. But for couples, individuals, or those looking to get a drink to go - the coffee here is very good!
Excellent cafe within walking distance from Skytree! Great coffee, lovely staff, and cute selection of plants and home decor items. Recommend the Espresso Tonic during the summer months!

1247.a: Japan, 〒101-0047 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Uchikanda, 2 Chome−11−8 神田西口ビル 別館 アヒージョ専門店 AJILLO アジロ 神田西口店

1247.ed: Diners like this restaurant's customizable ajillo, allowing them to choose their preferred oil and ingredients, and they highlight the delicious pasta and other dishes. They also mention the lively and clean atmosphere, along with the friendly and welcoming staff.

rv.t: Happened to pop by whilst looking for late night dinner walking around the town. We got the porcini mushroom pasta and the Japanese style one. Both were super flavourful and delicious. The sangria was also amazing, not too sweet which was perfect with the food. The staff were super kind, welcoming and friendly. Wish we tried the ajillo but it was a bit late so we didn’t want to overdo it. Maybe next time :)
absolute delicious!!! super hospitable and welcoming! highly recommend!

1248.ed: Diners like this pizzeria's delicious, authentic Neapolitan pizzas with flavorful, chewy crusts, and a wide variety of other tasty dishes, including pasta and appetizers. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, the lively atmosphere, and the good value for money. Some reviews mention the service can be slow.
1248.edj: ナポリの伝統的な製法を踏まえ、独自の手法で熟成させるピザ生地が売り。店先にテラス席があり、カジュアルにその他料理も楽しめる。

rv.t: One of the best pizzas in Tokyo (and that says a lot). I was very surprised to find this place in such a random residential area. We came on a Saturday and had to wait 30 minutes. It was definitely worth the wait. The pizza is delicious - the dough was heavenly. I am very surprised it’s not on Asia’s 50 Top Pizza list. It truly deserves a spot on there.

Pizza were fantastic. Menu is largely in jap, but the staff are amazing - the lady serving us even took the effort to explain the contents of the appetiser in English. Reservations is a must, as it's very popular with the locals.

It's such an interesting but obvious combination of combining a good pizza place with an Izakaya down a quiet neighborhood street. While the size of the restaurant and table locations are a bit weird as well as service being "okay" the rest seems to make up for it.

1249.a: Japan, 〒771-4102 Tokushima, Myodo District, Sanagochi, Kami, Okugawamata, 大川原高原
1249.aj: 〒771-4102 徳島県名東郡佐那河内村上奥川股 大川原高原

rv.t: 7月8日の平日でもたくさんの人が訪れてました この日の下界の気温は33℃高原は20℃夏はここで過ごしたいー 霧が発生してなかなか良い感じでした

平日に訪問しました。 当日はあいにくの雨模様で、期待していた高原からの景色は霧に包まれてしまい、遠くまで見渡すことはできませんでした。それでも、この時期ならではの紫陽花がとても綺麗に咲いていて、雨に濡れた花々は色鮮やかで、晴れの日とは違った趣があり十分楽しめました。天気は残念でしたが、自然の美しさを感じられる時間になりました。 これから訪れる方へ一つ注意点があります。Googleマップの案内に従って進むと、対向車とのすれ違いも大変なほど狭い山道へ案内される場合があります。実際に私もかなり細い道を走ることになり、運転には気を遣いました。遠回りになっても、現地の案内標識や車載ナビを参考に進んだ方が安心だと思います。 天気が良ければ絶景が楽しめる場所だと思うので、次回は晴れた日にもう一度訪れてみたいと思える高原でした。
tempatnya bagusss bgtt sayang kesana pas cuacanya lagi jelek😭😭 tapi tetep cantik bgttt

1250.a: 8base, 1 Chome-7-1 Uchisaiwaicho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0011, Japan
1250.aj: 〒100-0011 東京都千代田区内幸町１丁目７−１ 八戸都市圏交流プラザ エイトベース
1250.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious regional dishes, including senbei soup, fresh seafood, and chicken nanban, as well as the wide variety of local sake. They also highlight the warm service, reasonable prices, and the attached souvenir shop. Some reviews mention the portions can be small.
1250.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、せんべい汁、新鮮な魚介類、チキン南蛮など、この地域の美味しい料理を高く評価しています。また、日本酒の種類が豊富な点も好評です。温かいサービス、手頃な価格、併設されたお土産ショップも特徴として挙げられています。 クチコミの中には、料理の量が少ないという意見もあります。

rv.t: I visited on a Sunday around 1 PM, and it wasn't too busy—likely because the Tokyo Marathon made the area a bit tricky to navigate. We ordered the chicken nanban and the oyakodon, both of which were really tasty and high quality. They also sell a variety of souvenirs from Aomori, which was a nice touch. The prices were reasonable, and we really enjoyed our meal. I will definitely be back again!

Such a pleasant find! We were looking for a place that’s open. Went at 830pm - they told us last order was 830pm. We ordered 2 rounds of Kakubin highball (not on the menu but you can request cos they have whiskey), and ordered chicken meatball (add egg yolk). We also ordered kaku chips (so special!) and egg omelette either minced meat. Fantastic!
Great amazing food and mackerel

1251.a: Japan, 〒311-4142 Ibaraki, Mito, Higashiakatsuka, 2124 GREEN ROOM
1251.aj: 〒311-4142 茨城県水戸市東赤塚２１２４ GREEN ROOM
1251.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and voluminous dishes, such as the juicy chicken and fresh vegetable plates, and the menu offers a wide variety of options. They also highlight the stylish and comfortable atmosphere, making it a great spot for gatherings. Guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, providing excellent service.
1251.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ジューシーな若鶏のプレートや新鮮な野菜がたっぷり摂れるタコライスなど、美味しくてボリュームのある料理が高く評価されています。メニューの種類も豊富で、様々な料理を楽しめるようです。店内はスタイリッシュで居心地の良い雰囲気で、友人との集まりにも最適という声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかなサービスを提供しているという意見もあり、快適に過ごせるカフェとして評判です。

rv.t: As the name suggests, the meal comes with lots of vegetables. Their chicken with tartar sauce is good. Service is great. Staffs are friendly too.

星5.00★★★★★ 店内も外観もすごくオシャレで 雰囲気がいいです。 店長さんもわざわざ駐車場まで 案内してくださったりととても親切です。 常に満席で予約必須‼️のお店ですが、 混雑していてもお料理も割とすぐ提供されます！✨店内は基本的に女性同士のお客様が多いなという印象です。 うるさいってことはなく、 賑やかでお席同士が近くても 会話内容気にせずお食事時間を楽しめます😋 お料理もものすごくボリューミーで すっごく美味しいです✨ また予約して伺いたいです🫶🏻
予約した時間より早く着いたのですがスムーズに案内してくださいました！雰囲気がとても良くてなにより店員さんがほんとにほんとに素敵でした(;_;)料理もボリュームがあってすんごく美味しかったです！バースデープレートをお願いしたのですがとーっても可愛くて美味しくて母も大満足でした！！とにかく店員さんが素敵で男性の方も笑顔で出迎えて下さり良い誕生日に出来ました♪♪また行きたいです！ご馳走様でした>ᴗ<

1252.aj: 〒271-0092 千葉県松戸市松戸１１４９−１ G'ROOM（グリーンルーム）プラーレ松戸店 プラーレ松戸RF
catj: 地ビール レストラン
1252.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious Hawaiian-inspired dishes, including poke, pancakes, and avocado burgers, and appreciate the generous portion sizes. They also highlight the comfortable and spacious seating, including sofa and terrace options, and the relaxed, stylish atmosphere. Guests mention the attentive staff and quick service, even during busy periods.
1252.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ポケ、パンケーキ、アボカドバーガーなど、ハワイをイメージした美味しい料理と、そのボリュームが評価されています。また、ソファ席やテラス席があり、広々としていて快適な座席と、リラックスできるおしゃれな雰囲気が好評です。忙しい時間帯でも、スタッフの対応が丁寧で、料理の提供が早いという声もあります。

rv.t: Interesting take on American / Hawaiian food. Definitely has a Japanese twist, so the taste is not what I expected for several items and they are prepared differently. Take the escalator to the top, take a right, and then look for the stairs. The restaurant is on the rooftop.

Disappointing Pizza Experience at GRoom (Ito Yokado, Matsudo Station) I was very disappointed with my experience at GRoom on the 6th floor of the Ito Yokado building near Matsudo Station. The menu photo clearly shows what appears to be a proper round pizza, which naturally sets the expectation of a traditional pizza with a thinner crust and a reasonable amount of toppings. What was actually served was completely…

I been here million times. But it's my first time to write a review for them. Although we moved to different location. I kept coming back here when I'm in Matsudo or nearby town for my work. Because, the food here is really really tasty. And they have alot of unique taste- great food to offer. But eventhough it's sumptuous. Price is reasonable. Also the place is relaxing and comfy. Go check this place, so you can…

1253.a: Japan, 〒151-0066 Tokyo, Shibuya, Nishihara, 1 Chome−13−2 kasiki
1253.aj: 〒151-0066 東京都渋谷区西原１丁目１３−２ kasiki
1253.ed: People say this ice cream shop offers unique and delicious ice cream flavors, often featuring seasonal ingredients and creative combinations like olive oil vanilla. They also highlight the stylish, minimalist, and relaxing atmosphere, making it a pleasant spot to unwind. Others also mention the attentive and kind staff who provide excellent service and helpful recommendations.
1253.edj: このアイスクリーム店について、ユーザーのクチコミでは、ユニークで美味しいアイスクリームの味が評判です。季節の食材を使った創造的な組み合わせが多く、中にはオリーブオイルバニラのような珍しいフレーバーもあります。また、店内はスタイリッシュで無駄がなく、落ち着いた雰囲気が心地よく、リラックスできる場所として高く評価されています。さらに、スタッフの対応が丁寧で親切、そして的確なアドバイスをしてくれるという声も多くあります。

rv.t: Such a cute natural wine & ice cream spot with unique flavors. I tried the strawberry rosemary, lemon Earl Grey, and black sesame sea salt. Even though the staff said they’re dairy-based, the texture was still a bit icy/gritty, which I didn't love. But the vibe of this little place is great!

Came here late one night for tea and ice cream and it was delicious! The ice cream flavors were unique but really good flavor combinations. They have great tea as well so it makes for the perfect dessert spot after dinner. The interior is beautiful and very relaxing—highly recommend!

They offer unique ice cream flavors and good coffee. The interior design is also beautiful. Keep in mind that they only seat you once every one in your party has arrived, and the wait is outside. They have a second floor seating for customers who order drink + ice cream so it is actually more spacious than it seems from the outside.

1254.aj: 〒130-0012 東京都墨田区太平２丁目１８−１０ 天重

rv.a: なつ乃の食とお酒の記録
rv.t: 昭和の香り漂う外観からの店内、ランチギリギリだったから消灯してましたがいいよとのことでしたので入店。 年輪を沢山重ねた大将と奥様のご夫婦で営まれているよう。 老舗であろうに厨房内からとても綺麗にされていました。 天丼をいただきましたが香ばしくとても美味しい✩ *:゜ こーゆーのがいいのよねー、米粒ひとつも残しませんよ笑 とても美味しくいただきました！ またリピしたいお店です。
錦糸町の老舗店であなご天丼をいただく〜♪ 揚げたてサクサクな衣を纏ったフワフワで肉厚な穴子天が茄子と獅子唐と共に甘めのたれに浸かって提供されます😋 美味しい食事は人をシアワセにします -ごちそうさまでした-

1998年4月4日、俺は東京ドームにいた。 アントニオ猪木の引退スピーチは今もそらで言える。 冒頭はこんな感じ。 「人は歩みを止めた時に そして挑戦を諦めた時に 年老いていくのだと思います」 この言葉を思い出しながら天丼を待った。 店内は静寂で、天ぷらを揚げる油の音だけが響く。 ゆうに80歳は越えてると思われるご主人の腰は 80度くらいに曲がり、動きはスローモーションのよう。 奥さん（だと思う）に促されながら 天ぷらを揚げている。 勝手な想像だが、天ぷらを揚げて70年くらい。 勝手な想像ね。 贔屓目ではなく、 天ぷらのタレは俺史上、最高に好きな味。 つまりメチャクチャ旨い。 1000円という驚異的な価格での天丼。 エビ2尾、かき揚げ、なんかの魚、茄子。 衝撃のタレに使った天ぷらの旨いこと旨いこと。 冒頭の猪木の話に戻るが、 歩みを止めなくても、 悲しいかな人は老いていく。 老いによって歩みが止まる。 歩み続けると言うことは、…

1255.a: Japan, 〒111-0034 Tokyo, Taito City, Kaminarimon, 1 Chome−15−12 Sakurada, 永谷マンション1F
1255.aj: 〒111-0034 東京都台東区雷門１丁目１５−１２ 江戸料理 櫻田 永谷マンション1F
catj: すき焼き/しゃぶしゃぶ店
1255.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious sukiyaki and exceptional rice, which is often served in a clay pot and is said to be imperial-grade. They also highlight the traditional Edo-style atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff. Some reviews mention the value can be inconsistent.
1255.edj: 毎日築地で仕入れた魚介や鶏、鴨、猪、鹿、馬などを囲炉裏で炙って味わえる。昼は寿司、蕎麦、天ぷら他を提供。店内は江戸情緒溢れる。

rv.t: This is a small, family-run Japanese restaurant managed by an elderly lady. Although it is located near Kaminarimon in Asakusa, the atmosphere inside feels calm and relaxing. They offer a sukiyaki lunch set for 2,000 yen per person. The quality of the beef was very good, and the seasoning was well-balanced. It seemed to be Kanto-style sukiyaki, and even the rice was cooked really well. If you’re visiting Asakusa and…

Visiting Sakurada Edo Cuisine was such a special experience. This traditional restaurant has a wonderfully authentic Edo-style atmosphere that immediately transports you back in time. What made it truly memorable was the sweet elderly lady who serves the restaurant all by herself，her warmth and care make the experience feel personal and heartwarming. The dishes are classic and comforting, full of traditional…

A very unique traditional dining experience in Asakusa. At Sakurada, you sit around a traditional irori hearth and grill seafood, game, and seasonal vegetables over charcoal. The sound of the fire, the aroma from the grill, and the wooden Edo-style interior make it feel like stepping back in time. At the end of the meal, you can even light Japanese sparklers using the irori fire, which adds a special touch to the…

1256.a: Shinano Handmade Soba, ＭＳビル 2F 3 Chome-11-4 Narihira, Sumida City, Tokyo 130-0002, Japan
1256.aj: 〒130-0002 東京都墨田区業平３丁目１１−４ ＭＳビル 2F 手打ちそば 志な乃
1256.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba and udon, especially the "aimori" option that allows them to enjoy both types of noodles. They also highlight the flavorful kenchin-jiru and the variety of condiments provided. Guests mention the rich, tasty green tea and the calm, folk-art inspired interior.
1256.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しくて太く、コシのあるそばやうどんを高く評価しています。また、具だくさんで風味豊かなけんちん汁を挙げるクチコミも多くあります。提供される薬味の種類が豊富な点や、美味しいそば湯も好評です。店内は落ち着いた雰囲気でリラックスできるという声があり、スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかな対応だと評価されています。

rv.t: Very tasty noodles. The udon can get stuck together so if you order the udon and soba it might be better to eat the udon first. The soba yu was yummy
The noodles are thick and pleasantly uneven, which gives them a nice handmade feel. I was also told that the kenchin-jiru is worth trying.

Great soba and udon spot, authentic hand made noodle, super high quality, also try fish cakes . Very kind staff to foreigners. 5min walk from Skytree and Sumida Aquarium, total worth the walk vs just eating at tourist area at skytree

1257.a: Japan, 〒153-0052 Tokyo, Meguro City, Yutenji, 2 Chome−7−20 Ehosai, 倉方ビル1階
1257.aj: 〒153-0052 東京都目黒区祐天寺２丁目７−２０ 匯豐齋（えほうさい） 倉方ビル1階
1257.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Taiwanese cuisine, including popular dishes like stinky tofu, lu rou fan, and salt and pepper chicken, with many noting the generous portions. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly, kind staff, saying the atmosphere feels like home. Others mention the clean interior and the wide variety of menu options, making it suitable for sharing…
1257.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、本格的な台湾料理を高く評価しています。特に、臭豆腐、ルーロー飯、塩酥鶏などの人気メニューが挙げられており、ボリューム満点というクチコミが多くあります。また、手頃な価格と親切で感じの良いスタッフも好評で、アットホームな雰囲気が自宅にいるように感じられるという声もあります。その他、清潔な店内と豊富なメニューも特徴で、多くの料理をシェアするのに適しているという意見もあります。

rv.t: Finally found a good Taiwanese restaurant in Tokyo. Legit! Taiwanese owner and staff. They even have stinky tofu. We tried their morning glory, tempura, dumplings, stinky tofu, spring rolls and drunken chicken. All were great. Just like being in Taiwan! They even have Taiwan Beer.

Honestly the BEST restaurant in Tokyo. (I live here) every food we ordered was delicious, even the drinks were all so amazing! I recommend 盐酥鸡，臭豆腐，番茄炒饭，蚝煎……… tbh just order whichever cos they all tasted delicious. The ladies at the restaurant were all so friendly and kind! It felt like home even though I’m not even Taiwanese haha. Highly highly recommend this restaurant.

We ordered a few of their dishes, most of which were delicious. We absolutely loved the pancake one especially. It was a winner. The stinky tofu was our least favourite. The venue was welcoming, and a lot of customers spoke Mandarin, which was a reassuring sign. Service was decent. Prices were good for an ethnic restaurant in town.

1258.a: Japan, 〒140-0013 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Minamioi, 6 Chome−20−7 志乃田ビル 焼肉 牛星 大森店
1258.aj: 〒140-0013 東京都品川区南大井６丁目２０−７ 志乃田ビル 焼肉 牛星 大森店

rv.t: Great neighborhood yakiniku. Helpful staff, although they speak only little English. Food is reasonably priced. Good quality meats, avoid the beef liver though.

久々の再訪。レベルアップしました。お肉はムラがあります。高いから良いわけではないです。でもバランス良くお肉、野菜を頂けました。肉の価格は30%値上げしていますがお酒は据え置きなのが好印象!!私には合っています。また伺います!! ——————— 残念ながら普通より少し下のお店になってしまいました、本当に残念です。家焼肉に勝てないかと。 まず元々スタッフのレベルはかなり低かったのですが、コロナ禍で客が少ないのでなんとか誤魔化せていたのが今は通用していません。注文も伝わらないし、客がマスクなしで大声で騒いでも放置、注文受けたついでに皿やグラスも下げられない、ちょっと今のご時世無理かと。 店長や、社員さんもわかってると思いますが売上重視なんでしょう、信頼できないので入れません。帰りました。…

肉質はあまり良くないけど値段を考えるとまあ妥当かなというレベル。 この価格帯で炭火焼なのは良いと思います。 上タン塩：定番だけど追加で130円くらいのネギと一緒に食べるのが良いと思う。 サガリ：メニュー写真と違い明らかに黒ずんで変色していた。しっかり火を通してもやはり臭みが出ていて残念だけど新鮮なら600円程度だからありかなとは思う。 特上ミノ：凍ったままのところもあったけどまあよくあるミノ。それなりに美味しいです。 ホルモン：同じくよくある感じだけど脂の甘味とか旨味は少し薄めに感じた。 ヒレ切り落とし：こちらも少し変色していて臭みがあったけどまあ値段を考えればお得だと思います。 クッパ：こちらも薄味だけど美味しかった。人参だけ何故か他の具材より大切りでちょっと火が通りきってない感じで少し硬かったけど締めには良いと思います。 あとハイボールは濃い目にしないとかなり薄いと思います。ニッカだからそこはもう少し頑張って欲しいところ。

1259.a: Sumibi-yakiniku Yamamoto, 2 Chome-5-18 Hamasakicho, Ishigaki, Okinawa 907-0013, Japan
1259.aj: 〒907-0013 沖縄県石垣市浜崎町２丁目５−１８ 炭火焼肉 やまもと

rv.t: A local Yakiniku place where it’s run like a family restaurant. We got the family set and single set with a few extra meat and it was honestly more than enough! Most favorite were the harami and rosu with the most perfect marbling. As someone who was raised in Kobe, this hits the spot perfectly between lean and fat. If you’re in Ishigaki, this is a definite must try!

The famous Yamamoto yakiniku. Years ago I came here a few times in its old location. It was a real find and you had to book days in advance. That has turned to weeks and months, the venue has changed and become less cosy. The timed slot is for 1.5 hours with last orders 1 hour in. It’s really hard to have a relaxing meal here because it’s rush rush rush. The smoke fans don’t work very well either. The drinks…

Awesome Ishigaki beef. Place is packed with tourists so you need a reservation. We were lucky to have a local friend that made a reservation for us and we had our dinner together with local friend at 8pm. Apparently after a certain time, it is only open to the locals.
